Senior Software Engineer Role overview Emergent 3 is hiring a full-stack Senior Software Engineer to own its web administration portal and backend APIs, Chrome extension, and Windows and macOS desktop application. These products help schools and organizations manage emergency alerts, coordinate incident response, and account for people during an emergency. You will lead work across three codebases, from technical design through production release. You will collaborate with product, design, QA, and mobile engineering to keep alerts reliable and ensure that supported clients continue to work as services and applications evolve. Key responsibilities Web administration and APIs. Build and maintain Laravel features across the admin portal, REST APIs, and MySQL. Own changes to alert workflows, role-based permissions, integrations, and the background jobs that support them. Desktop application. Maintain the Electron app on Windows and macOS, including native notifications, tray behavior, deep links, and automatic updates. Own installer packaging, code signing, macOS notarization, and release verification. Chrome extension. Maintain the Manifest V3 alert extension, including permissions, device registration, background processing, and audible alerts. Prepare, validate, and release extension updates. Trace alert delivery from queued jobs and real-time broadcasts through to the desktop or browser. Verify behavior after reconnects, sleep and resume, and client restarts. Investigate missed, delayed, or duplicate alerts. Improve automated tests, deployment checks, and production monitoring. Lead technical design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and document operational and release procedures. EMERGENT3 / ENGINEERING 1 / 2 Job Description Page 2 of 2Emergent 3 Required qualifications Senior-level experience building and operating production full-stack applications with Laravel, PHP, and MySQL. Proficiency with Eloquent, schema migrations, indexing, query performance, and authenticated REST APIs. Strong JavaScript, TypeScript, and React skills. Familiarity with server-rendered Laravel interfaces, Node.js and npm tooling, Composer dependency management, and collaborative Git workflows. Hands-on experience developing and releasing desktop applications on Windows and macOS. Working knowledge of Electron’s main and renderer processes, preload scripts, and secure inter-process communication. Experience with installers, code signing, and update validation. Familiarity with Chrome extensions and Manifest V3, including service worker lifecycles, content scripts, extension messaging, and permissions. Experience with Redis-backed queues or caching and real-time features using WebSockets or an equivalent transport. Ability to diagnose failures across client, server, and infrastructure boundaries. Familiarity with local development tooling including Laravel Valet, OrbStack, Takeout, MinIO for S3-compatible storage, and MailHog for email testing. Experience securing authentication, permissions, and sensitive data, and verifying changes through automated tests, cross-platform testing, and production diagnostics. Demonstrated technical ownership and experience mentoring engineers. Preferred qualifications Experience with Blade, Livewire, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, and with Laravel Horizon, Octane, Sanctum, or Reverb. Experience publishing extensions through the Chrome Web Store or distributing desktop software to managed fleets. Familiarity with electron-builder, MSI, NSIS, DMG, and S3-backed update delivery. Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines or comparable CI/CD tooling, Pest or PHPUnit, PHPStan, Sentry, or Laravel Echo and Pusher-compatible broadcasting. Experience with SAML single sign-on, roster integrations, or emergency communications and other time-sensitive systems. EMERGENT3 / ENGINEERING 2 / 2 Job Description How to apply Email your résumé as a PDF to careers@emergent3.com with the subject Senior Software Engineer | Your name. In the same email, include a viewable link to a 60 to 90 second video introducing yourself and describing one relevant project you shipped or maintained. Both items are required for interview consideration. Email the hiring inbox to request an accommodation. You don’t require a support system to maintain momentum.Experience with queue/job-centric backends is a plus.Experience with building production systems where data ingestion from third-party APIs is critical to the business is a big plus.BenefitsThe company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. opportunities.descriptionText: Headquarters: New York, NY URL: https://edconic.com/ Job Title: Front-End Developer Location: Fully Remote (US) Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales Reports to: Director of Web Development Classification: Regular, Full-time FLSA Status: Exempt Prepared by: Global Head of Creative Prepared Date: 10/1/26 Salary range:  $85,000–$100,000 About Edconic Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals. Our Mission: Edconic exists to help learners stand out, move forward, and build meaningful futures in the fields that inspire them. We bring together education and industry, partnering with iconic global organizations to create transformative learning experiences. Our programs are created and delivered by educators and industry practitioners, giving learners access to professional experts, real world challenges, and practical skills. As early career opportunities shrink, we offer credibility, connections, and hands on experience that internships once provided. We prepare learners not simply for their first job but for a lifetime of growth.  Our values • Transformative education: relationship-rich, experiential learning that draws out each learner’s potential. • Belonging: a community where learners, educators, experts, and staff can bring their authentic selves and support one another. • Stewardship: as a family-owned organization, we think in generations, developing talent, caring for our partnerships, and building an impact that lasts. The Role We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity. You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read. What You'll Do Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech. Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand. Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass. Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack. Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit. What You Bring 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress. The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields. Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript. Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line. A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO. Experience building and testing HTML emails. Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff. A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once. Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented. Bonus Experience Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns. Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing). CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement). Multilingual WordPress sites. A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue. UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. How We Use AI AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same. AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process. Location, Travel & Eligibility Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required. Must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome. Our Commitment Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Our in-house web development team works closely together on a wide range of multifaceted and customized projects. This role contributes to the development of high-quality, accessible, and maintainable websites and web applications for OCALI clients and staff. The Staff Web Developer is a developer-first, product-minded team member who looks beyond the immediate request to understand user needs, clarify goals, identify risks and solution options, and develop accessible, sustainable web solutions that effectively address the underlying problem. This staff member is expected to ask thoughtful questions, contribute technical insight, share knowledge with team members, and support the successful delivery of web solutions. The employee must be available to work on-site and collaborate in person at the office as needed for meetings, planning, project coordination, team collaboration, and other job-related responsibilities. Develop, test, deploy, modernize, and maintain custom websites, web applications, reusable components, templates, and integrations using established development standards and technology stack. Write clean, maintainable, accessible, and well-documented code that supports consistency, scalability, security, and long-term maintenance. Troubleshoot, test, resolve, and document bugs, accessibility issues, production problems, and other assigned technical needs. Participate in technical planning, solution design, quality assurance, code review, release activities, and improvement of existing websites and applications. Collaborate with product owners, technical project managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand goals, clarify requirements, identify user needs, surface risks or gaps, and translate approved requirements into functional, accessible web solutions. Communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, project status, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Maintain accurate technical documentation for applications, components, workflows, and development standards, and share technical knowledge with team members. Manage assigned work according to identified priorities, including tracking time toward client contract work as required. Perform other specific job-related duties as directed by senior leadership. Minimum Qualifications: Associate degree or higher preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Strong front-end development skills, including HTML, CSS/Sass, JavaScript, responsive layouts, and reusable interface components. Experience with Bootstrap, jQuery, Alpine JS, Livewire, Laravel, Laravel Filament, NPM, and Laravel Mix or similar tools. Experience with Gitflow, pull requests, code review, testing, release practices, and collaborative development workflows. Working knowledge of web accessibility standards and best practices. Demonstrated ability to analyze requirements, ask clarifying questions, identify risks or gaps, provide technical recommendations, and deliver effective web solutions within established priorities and timelines. Ability to communicate technical concepts, recommendations, risks, and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to manage web content and interface details with accuracy, consistency, and sound judgment. Ability to rapidly adapt to changing web technologies and quickly adopt new systems and approaches. Documentation of a clear criminal record in compliance with state statute. Complies with drug-free workplace rules and Board policies. Preferred Qualifications: Experience designing or maintaining component-based interfaces, design systems, or shared front-end patterns. Experience using Figma, Adobe Illustrator, or similar tools to support interface planning and collaboration. Experience with user-centered design, usability testing, product discovery, or related UX practices. What's in it for you?
